capacity_assumptions.capacity_treatment: Inpatient beds capacity is reported contemporaneously with daily census and is NOT assumed known during forecast horizon. It is excluded from autoregressive feature inputs.

evaluation_summary.notes: Ridge Regression achieves lower MAE than the Seasonal Naive baseline on the 7-day holdout set (1000.0 vs 1154.29), but Seasonal Naive achieves lower RMSE (1375.69 vs 1441.4) because recursive multi-step ML predictions compound errors on later horizon steps. XGBoost underperforms the baseline under recursive rollout.
